input.title: Input
input.description: The domain or URL as given in the input.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Domain without www. (null for invalid input lines).

status.title: Status
status.description: found, notFound, blocked, robotsDisallowed, unreachable, invalidInput or error.

sourceUrl.title: Impressum page
sourceUrl.description: URL of the Impressum / legal-notice page the fields come from.

companyName.title: Company
companyName.description: Legal company name as written in the Impressum, including the legal form.

legalForm.title: Legal form
legalForm.description: Legal form: GmbH, AG, UG (haftungsbeschränkt), GmbH & Co. KG, e.K., SE, Sàrl, SAS, ...

address.title: Address
address.description: Street, postal code and city in one line.

countryGuess.title: Country
countryGuess.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country guessed from the VAT ID, register type, court, address, phone prefix and TLD.

email.title: Email
email.description: Generic contact mailbox shown on the page (info@, kontakt@, office@, ...). Personal addresses are never output.

registerCourt.title: Register court
registerCourt.description: Register court or registry: Amtsgericht (DE), Handelsgericht/Landesgericht (AT), Handelsregisteramt (CH) or RCS city (FR).

registerType.title: Register type
registerType.description: HRB, HRA, GnR, PR, VR (DE), FN (AT), CHE (CH UID), RCS or SIREN (FR).

registerNumber.title: Register number
registerNumber.description: Register number with its prefix, e.g. HRB 60405, FN 482913 k, CHE-317.482.905 or RCS Lyon 842 315 907.

vatId.title: VAT ID
vatId.description: VAT ID (USt-IdNr., UID, MWST, TVA) without spaces, e.g. DE813501887, ATU71839245, CHE-317.482.905 MWST.

pagesFetched.title: Pages fetched
pagesFetched.description: HTTP requests made for this domain, robots.txt included.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why no Impressum was found (blocked, unreachable, ...), else null.
